item.title: Forty Years Ago, One Car Won The War On Total Number Of ‘Turbo’ Logos
item.description: Pity the turbocharger. Today, nobody seems to care about it; it’s as ubiquitous as tire valve stem caps. Virtually any car or truck you buy comes standard with some sub-two-liter engine packing at least one if not two blowers and pumps out over 200 horses and gets 35mpg. That wasn’t always the case.
